page.overview:
What is Amaravati?

Amaravati is the childe of al-Ashrad and current Amr of the Assamites in Alamut.

An accomplished sorcerer himself, Amaravati held the last Seat of Tongues at the Council of Scrolls.

During the schism of the clan, Amaravati did not follow his sire and instead allied with Ur-Shulgi, who declared him the new Amr.
